name: custom.salesforce_search_contacts
key_help: Connect with Salesforce sign-in. The access token and your instance address come from the connection.
description: Search your own Salesforce contacts by name: title, email and account. Read only.

name.description: Part of the name. Letters, numbers, spaces and . & , - only.

query.q: SELECT Id, Name, Title, Email, Account.Name FROM Contact WHERE Name LIKE '%{name}%' LIMIT 10
